name: Blunt Spinecurve
description: Pull the saber from the scabbard in one motion and cut diagonally across the opponent's near arm or ribs.

name: Firm Yelman
description: Draw the curved belly of the blade across the target while stepping through so the cut slices instead of chopping.

name: Basketlid
description: Slant the blade so an incoming cut slides along the spine and off to the side.

name: Light Basket
description: Slide the lead foot forward half a pace to close the distance while the blade stays ready at the shoulder.

name: Bellycowl
description: Roll the wrist to bring the saber back to guard after a cut so the next strike follows without pause.

name: Whirlblow
description: Raise the saber behind the head and chop straight down onto the opponent's guard or shoulder from a firm stance.

name: Level Knucklebow
description: Drive the saber point straight at the chest with the rear leg pushing the body behind the thrust.

name: Sudden Whirl
description: Whip the blade across the body at shoulder height with the back of the hand leading.

name: Swell Cowl
description: Hold the blade flat across the body with the off hand bracing the spine to stop a heavy overhead blow.
first_area: Chapter 005 — The House With No Walls (Ref: 1.1.1.005)

name: Light Gallop
description: Turn on the lead heel and step the rear foot back to leave the line of an incoming cut.

name: Swipewedge
description: Tap the opponent's blade aside with the back edge to open a line for the next cut.

name: Flourish Blow
description: Cut upward from low guard along the single edge to catch the opponent's forearm or jaw.

name: Wide Falsedge
description: Flick the false edge up under the opponent's wrist with a short snap of the forearm.

name: Folded Backedge
description: Set the shoulders and meet a cut with the forte of the blade held firm against the blow.

name: Baskettrot
description: Cross the rear foot past the lead foot to cover ground quickly while keeping the blade pointed at the target.

name: Belly Lid
description: Lay the spine over the opponent's blade and press down to hold it low for one breath.

name: Whirldash
description: Snap the wrist at the end of a forehand cut so the edge bites and the blade is already returning.

name: Pipeback Dash
description: Snap the wrist through a backhand cut across the body and return the blade to the shoulder.

name: Swift Knucklebow
description: Spring forward from a coiled stance and drive the point at the opponent's throat or chest.

name: Basket Drop
description: Swing the blade in a flat figure eight at the wrist to keep the edge moving between cuts.

name: Lowered Pipeback
description: Hold a low balanced stance with the blade angled forward so no single push can tip the body.

name: Sideways Yelman
description: Shuffle both feet in short skips to change the angle of attack without lifting out of guard.

name: Yelmanhusk
description: Rap the heel of the hilt into the opponent's wrist or ribs when the blade is too close to cut.

name: Hooding Backedge
description: Hang the blade point down above the lead knee so a cut at the head or arm glances away.
first_area: Chapter 005 — The House With No Walls (Ref: 1.1.1.005)

name: Bellydash
description: Whip the blade up out of the hanging guard to cut the opponent's wrist as the parry ends.

name: Resting Belly
description: Brace the sword arm against the hilt and take a blow on the forte with the bones locked.
first_area: Chapter 005 — The House With No Walls (Ref: 1.1.1.005)

name: Falsedge Stay
description: Drop the point and let a low cut slip along the blade before turning it aside.

name: Swellamble
description: Step back out of reach while drawing the blade into guard in the same motion.

name: Counterguard Dash
description: Prick the opponent's hand or forearm with the point in a short thrust from guard.

name: Skimmer Hit
description: Cut in one smooth arc from the right shoulder down across the body to the left hip.

name: Yelmanblow
description: Reverse the same arc from low left hip up across the body to the right shoulder.

name: Snug Yelman
description: Turn the hips at the end of a long cut so the blade comes back to guard before a counter lands.

name: Steady Swell
description: Feel the edge settle in the grip before each cut so the blade never turns flat on the target.

name: Gallophop
description: Step long with the lead foot as the arc begins so the cut reaches a retreating opponent.

name: Firm Spinecurve
description: Send a thin pulse of qi into the edge as a forehand cut lands so the blade bites a little deeper.

name: Downward Whirl
description: Seed the edge with a pulse of qi at the start of a backhand cut across the body.

name: Wide Slantcut
description: Lunge off the rear foot and let a pulse of qi carry the point into the opponent's chest.

name: Swellhusk
description: Drag the rear foot back while the blade turns an incoming cut aside along its spine.

name: Swipe Amble
description: Circle on the heels with a breath of qi in the legs to move around the opponent's weapon side.

name: Catching Flourish
description: Step in and beat the opponent's blade aside with the forte to open the line for a cut.

name: Kept Backedge
description: Retreat in even paces while holding the blade across the body and a thin qi stream along the spine.

name: Hard Belly
description: Root the feet and draw the blade in a single hard cut with qi sent down through the legs.

name: Downward Skimmer
description: Cut long and low from the shoulder as a rider does at a passing foe reaching with the whole arm.

name: Open Swell
description: Slash across the opponent's side while moving past and recover the blade to guard behind.

name: Tight Basket
description: Hold the off hand as if on the reins to keep the shoulders square behind the blade guard.
first_area: Chapter 005 — The House With No Walls (Ref: 1.1.1.005)

name: Basketstrike
description: Rise on the toes and cut with the arm fully extended to reach a target beyond normal range.

name: Yelmanwedge
description: Land from a leap or dismount with knees bent and the blade already raised to cover the head.

name: Quiet Slantcut
description: Move in a steady trotting rhythm that keeps the blade level and ready to cut at any beat.

name: Gallopblow
description: Pull the curved belly of the blade across the target while a pulse of qi runs along the edge.

name: Bellypause
description: Meet a cut with the spine and slide the opponent's blade down and away from the hand.

name: Fixing Whirl
description: Turn the edge into the opponent's blade at the moment of contact to jar the grip.

name: Bright Flourish
description: Rake the belly of the blade up under the opponent's guard to cut the inner arm.

name: Holding Counterguard
description: Lever the opponent's blade away using the spine as a fulcrum against the guard.

name: Gallopbump
description: Slash with a thin thread of qi running the length of the edge to sharpen the cut.

name: Blunt Pipeback
description: Stab with the qi thread gathered at the point so it pierces cloth and leather.

name: Soft Falsedge
description: Hold a thin steady stream of qi along the edge while walking and keep it through a cut.

name: Holding Knucklebow
description: Flash the threaded edge across an incoming blade to turn it aside in a quick short arc.

name: Yelmanpace
description: Skip forward or back on a pulse of qi in the soles to shift the line of attack.

name: Folded Yelman
description: Let the qi stream drop away after a cut and bring the blade back to a plain guard.

name: Locking Gallop
description: Beat the opponent's blade with the spine while a pulse of qi sets the hit ringing in the grip.

name: Forward Knucklebow
description: Draw from the scabbard mouth with the thumb guiding the edge and cut before the blade clears fully.

name: Settled Spinecurve
description: Bring the blade back across the body after the draw cut into a ready guard.

name: Ready Backedge
description: Slide the half-drawn blade against the scabbard to turn a sudden cut at the hand.
first_area: Chapter 005 — The House With No Walls (Ref: 1.1.1.005)

name: Short Gallop
description: Pull the blade back toward the body through the target while stepping away from the reply.

name: Yelmancowl
description: Hold the saber half returned to its scabbard as a calm guard that invites a rash attack.
first_area: Chapter 005 — The House With No Walls (Ref: 1.1.1.005)

name: Skipping Belly
description: Step forward in time with the draw so the body weight carries the blade out and through.

name: Level Swipe
description: Cut across the front of an approaching person to stop them short without wounding them.

name: Angled Counterguard
description: Parry a cut aimed past the watch post by turning the blade without leaving the standing line.

name: Swellstay
description: Stand a long watch with the saber point low and the legs relaxed yet ready to move.

name: Skimmer Pace
description: Step back one pace and raise the blade so others on watch see the danger.

name: Downward Slantcut
description: Slash down at the shoulder of an attacker who has pushed past the challenge.
